_readme: Yeh file 'har baar unique design' ka raaz hai.
gateway/sitegen.py har lead ke liye ek seed choose karta hai (lead id + din se deterministic,)
taake same lead dobara generate karne pe wahi design aaye, lekin alag-alag leads ke designs alag hoins.
palette x font x layout x hero = 8*8*6*6 = 2304 combinations. AI ko exact tokens dete hain (CSS values),
is liye woh 'random accha' nahi balki 'specified accha' banata hai.
Apne pasand ke colors add kar sakte hain — bas structure same rakhein.

layouts.desc: Hero = 50/50 split (left text, right image collage), asymmetric, no centered block
Hero = full viewport background image + bottom-left text block, transparent nav that solidifies on scroll
Hero = bento/masonry grid of unequal tiles (hours, offer, rating, photo) with hover lift
Thin top marquee strip with offers, then oversized single-line heading, then horizontal scroll cards
Left column sticky (brand + CTA + hours), right column scrolls through sections
Numbered editorial list (01/02/03) for services, hairline dividers, big type, minimal cards

heroes.desc: heading line-mask reveal animation (each line slides up behind a clip)
tiny uppercase kicker + huge 2-line heading + one supporting paragraph + dual CTA
auto-scrolling ticker of menu items / services under the hero
star rating + review count above the fold as the trust hook, then heading
rotating circular badge sticker ('NEW — BOOK ON WHATSAPP') overlapping the hero image
no image in hero: just massive typography, an underline flourish, and a ghost button

textures: large radial glow behind accent text
dotted grid background on one section only
soft noise via inline SVG feTurbulence
rules: max 2 fonts, exactly 1 accent colour used for actions only
radius must be consistent: pick one of 0px, 10px, 18px, 999px and stick to it
one deliberate asymmetry somewhere (offset image, overlapping card)
sections separated by spacing, not by borders everywhere
sticky bottom CTA bar only on mobile (max-width 640px)
